description: Designly is a commercial Art Direction and Design Neural Mesh plugin with 21 focused Skills, 16 custom Codex agents, a production Workflow Prompt Library grounded in the real routing graph, Cannes-calibrated Creative Direction, 571 Legendary Campaign Canon, dramaturgy-first AI Video Direction (Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0, Veo), model-physics Image Direction (Nano Banana 2/Pro, GPT Image 2), Insight Mining, Brand Activation, Visual Storytelling, Taste Engine, Reference Memory, bounded-edit sanitization, Arabic RTL direction, and independent Visual QA.

defaultPrompt: Open the Designly Workflow Prompt Library and route my real design job through the correct Skills.
Art-direct this campaign end-to-end, using specialist handoffs and strict release gates.

interface.longDescription:
Designly turns a real brief, approved idea, reference set, edit request, or campaign into production-ready visual work through explicit specialist routing

The Workflow Prompt Library provides long-form copy-ready prompts that activate Designly's existing Skills, typed handoffs, fail-close edit contracts, model physics, and Visual QA instead of using toy demo scenarios

It shapes creative concepts, dramaturgy, composition, typography, optics, and model physics (Seedance, Kling, Veo, Nano Banana, GPT Image 2), executes through compatible host tools when available, and routes targeted revisions when outputs fail

You can also sanitize annotation-guided inpainting, follow brand guidelines, handle Arabic and RTL layouts, preserve reference taste without imitation, and maintain visual continuity across multi-asset campaigns
